topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Finding out about the lies was like stumbling upon a hidden room in an old, familiar house. I saw a new side to my friend, one I hadn't expected. It's strange how a single revelation can reshape everything you thought you knew. I've been contemplating what honesty truly means in friendship, and how even the most intricate of deceptions can unravel, leaving threads of truth behind. I want to talk to them, to understand why they chose this path. Maybe there's a story there, a reason that deserves a listening ear. It's a chance to see deeper, to learn something about both of us.
